continuity: Jin’s allied force was pursued by hundreds of reanimated enemies after marching without proper rest; Jin killed the pursuers, and the effect of his sword striking at the watching crow is unknown.
Ma Sanbao serves the Blood Lord and was assigned to covertly watch Jin’s force; that surveillance was detected, first by Great Sir in Ningxia.

The East Depot’s information network had shared its view with Dark Heaven through the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord; the Grand Mage suspects the surviving Hyeoncheon and Kongtong Disciples went to Great Sir.
plot: Jin’s exhausted allied force is pursued by hundreds of reanimated enemies. He charges ahead while the Bow Saint and Jeok Cheongang support the force, then kills the attackers. A black-winged crow watches; Jin throws a sword at it, but its fate is not shown.

Ma Sanbao reports that Jin’s force detected his surveillance. The Grand Mage learns that a figure known as Great Sir in Ningxia was the first to notice it. She suspects Hyeoncheon and the Kongtong survivors may have gone to Great Sir, but does not know who he is.
translation_decisions: Render 대인 as “Great Sir,” the name used for the mysterious figure in Ningxia.

open_questions: Who is Great Sir, and what is his connection to Hyeoncheon and the surviving Kongtong Disciples?
Did Jin’s sword strike kill or otherwise affect the watching crow?
Are Dark Heaven’s forces broadly composed of reanimated corpses, and has Ma Sanbao spread the Corpse Art to others?
What is the Lord of Heaven seeking through Jin, and when will he appear?
